intent: A god's mausoleum: a colossal sarcophagus sealed behind a gold door ajar on a dark sanctum, inside a white pedimented cella on an ivory stepped plinth with a gilded processional stair, guardian colossi, a colonnade and its own seal-of-light effect.

critic.best_shot: feature-shots-final: pedimented cella with guardians on the stair
critic.why: An unmistakable temple tomb; the game camera sits inside it and plans repeat.

role: Landmark: mausoleum as a dungeon mouth or quest end.
notes:
# H
